title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Linguistic Annotation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21291v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Assessing large language models for linguistic annotation requires task-specific evaluation under documented conditions. We present dhAIBench, a Python benchmarking and annotation tool with a web interface for exploring and sharing results. It records prompts, configurations and predictions, enabling comparisons of annotation quality, confidence calibration, repeatability and estimated cost. We demonstrate the framework and the associated methodology through 293 runs of 48 models on nine linguistic annotation tasks spanning morphology, syntax, semantics, discourse-pragmatics, spelling normalization and learner-language correction. Models achieve high agreement with reference annotations on several tasks, including those on non-standardized, historical varieties as well as requiring contextual interpretation. translated_title: 面向语言学标注的大语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 评估大语言模型用于语言学标注需要在有据可查的条件下进行任务特定的评估。我们提出了 dhAIBench，这是一个 Python 基准测试与标注工具，并配有用于探索和分享结果的网页界面。该工具记录提示词、配置和预测结果，从而支持对标注质量、置信度校准、可重复性以及预估成本进行比较。我们通过 48 个模型在九项语言学标注任务上的 293 次运行来演示该框架及相关方法论，这些任务涵盖形态学、句法、语义学、篇章—语用学、拼写规范化以及学习者语言纠错。模型在多项任务上与参考标注达到了高度一致，其中包括涉及非标准化历史语言变体的任务以及需要语境解释的任务。研究结果支持针对特定语言学任务来评估模型，而非依赖通用排名。为此，我们……
tldr: 本文提出了带网页界面的 Python 语言学标注基准工具 dhAIBench，通过对 48 个模型在九项语言学标注任务上的 293 次运行进行系统评估，证明应依据特定语言任务的标注质量而非通用排名来评价大语言模型。
en_tdlr: We present dhAIBench, a Python benchmarking and annotation tool with a web interface that systematically evaluates 48 LLMs across nine linguistic annotation tasks over 293 runs, demonstrating that models should be assessed against task-specific linguistic annotation quality rather than general rankings.
